# Implementation Instructions
- make sure that you read all other instruction files in this directory
- follow all instructions in those files carefully
- if you are unsure about anything, ask for clarification
- if you find any contradictions between instruction files, ask for clarification
- if you find any contradictions between instruction files and the existing codebase, ask for clarification
- create a plan.md file inside the .github directory that outlines your approach to implementing the project
- if a plan.md file already exists, review it and start implementing the project based on that plan
- in the plan.md file, include a list of tasks that you will complete to implement the project
- make sure to break down large tasks into smaller, manageable tasks
- prioritize tasks based on their importance and dependencies
- once a task is completed, mark it as done in the plan.md file
- once a task is completed, commit your changes with a clear and concise commit message
- make sure to follow best practices for commit messages
- create a readme.md file in the root directory that provides an overview of the project
- in the readme.md file, include instructions on how to set up and run the project
- in the readme.md file, include any other relevant information about the project
- make sure to keep the readme.md file up to date as the project evolves
